stumbles.why: The text says up to 4 retries, which is 5 attempts in total. Four 503s would therefore not exhaust the retries, because a fifth attempt would still follow. I can't tell whether the fifth attempt also returns 503 or whether the limit is really 4 attempts. The test description and the retry count seem to disagree.

point: The Turso client's execute() now retries HTTP 503 and 429 up to 4 times with jittered exponential backoff. This fixes cold-start 503s that were wrongly reported as auth failures, and it leaves other statuses failing immediately.
